evals.name: hook-notice-runs-the-read-only-check
evals.prompt: A hook just said markdown-format found no markdownlint-cli2. Is it installed here?
evals.expected_output: Reads the setup skill's check section, runs only that check, and reports its PASS/FAIL table for markdownlint-cli2. Installs nothing and stops.
expectations: Follows only the `check` section of /markdown-format:setup and reports its PASS/FAIL table
Counts a repo-local node_modules/.bin/markdownlint-cli2 as well as one on PATH, as the hook does
Does not run `apply`, `npm install`, `npx`, or any download
Stops after the table instead of continuing into remediation

evals.name: install-request-is-routed-not-performed
evals.prompt:
/markdown-format:check

The check failed. Just install markdownlint for me.
evals.expected_output: Does not install from this skill. Names /markdown-format:setup apply as the successor for an explicit install request.
expectations: Does not install markdownlint-cli2 itself and does not invoke `npx`
Names /markdown-format:setup apply as the route for an install the user asked for
Does not claim markdownlint-cli2 is now installed

evals.name: passing-check-has-no-successor
evals.expected_output: When markdownlint-cli2 resolves, reports PASS and stops without suggesting setup apply.
expectations: Reports the PASS/FAIL table from the check section
When jq resolves, the table includes a jq PASS row
On a PASS, does not suggest /markdown-format:setup apply

evals.name: jq-probe-runs-under-check
evals.prompt:
/markdown-format:check

This repository has a markdownlint config (it opted in) and jq is not installed.
evals.expected_output: Runs the jq probe itself via Bash, reports a jq FAIL row with a remediation line, and installs nothing.
expectations: Runs a jq probe itself via Bash (such as `command -v jq`) instead of reading a pre-computed row from the setup skill
Reports a jq FAIL row with a remediation line
Does not install jq, does not run `apply`, and modifies no file
